name: Elixir of Agony
summary: In the Undercity, Lydon's freshly mashed Mudsnout Composite awaits refinement. Apothecary Lydon sends it from Tarren Mill to Master Apothecary Faranell, who must treat it with a colloid of decay as the Royal Apothecary Society develops a new plague for the Forsaken.

sections.title: A Courier to the Capital
sections.body: The Royal Apothecary Society sends raw discoveries from its regional researchers to the Undercity for specialized refinement. In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon has mashed local Mudsnout Blossoms into a composite. Only the capital's laboratory holds the advanced reagents needed to bring his work to lethal fruition.

sections.title: The Master's Urgency
sections.body: Master Apothecary Faranell works under pressure in the Apothecarium. The Scourge threatens from the north, while aggressive human populations press from the south. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner has demanded a potent new plague to defend the Forsaken. Lydon's composite could give Faranell the toxic breakthrough the Dark Lady expects.

faq.q: Why do I need to take the Mudsnout Composite to the Undercity?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill lacks the reagents to finish this stage of his experiment. Master Apothecary Faranell has a colloid of decay in the Apothecarium, and he must apply it to the Mudsnout Composite before the mixture can progress.

Master Apothecary Faranell leads the Royal Apothecary Society from his laboratory deep in the Undercity. He oversees the Forsaken's major chemical and alchemical research and answers directly to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

faq.q: What is the new plague the apothecaries keep mentioning?
faq.answer: The new plague is an ongoing Forsaken project commanded by Lady Sylvanas. It is engineered to annihilate both the living and the undead Scourge, giving the Forsaken an absolute weapon against their enemies.

faq.q: Where can I find Master Apothecary Faranell?
faq.answer: Faranell resides in the Apothecarium, the Undercity's southwestern quarter, devoted entirely to alchemy, poison brewing, and surgical experimentation.

faq.q: What is Apothecary Lydon trying to create?
faq.answer: Lydon is concocting the Elixir of Agony, an intensely virulent toxin brewed from Hillsbrad flora and decay agents. It is designed to prove the effectiveness of new strains in the field.

faq.q: Why is the Royal Apothecary Society so rushed?
faq.answer: The Forsaken face threats on every side. The Scourge of Northrend threatens to overrun them, while human resistance from the south applies relentless pressure. A decisive biological weapon is urgently needed.

angles.text: As an Undead, each batch of raw plant matter delivered to Faranell helps secure the Forsaken's survival and sovereign defense against the living and the Scourge.
As a member of the Horde, you rely on Forsaken territory to hold northern Lordaeron. The Royal Apothecary Society's research helps defend those vulnerable borders.
